package: nLab Framework 1.1.2 — Shadow Sage Generative Palette
purpose: Rendre le thème Shadow Sage indépendant d'une couleur fixe : une couleur dominante choisie par alias ou HEX régénère automatiquement la palette cohérente du thème.
behavior: Changing dominant_color recolors UI controls, soft surfaces, page tint and hero gradients.
Geometry, shadows, spacing, toolbar and floating-window behavior do not change with color.
Default green profile preserves the validated reference appearance.
Projects can still override any generated token after palette generation.

examples.result: blue primary + derived pale blue + contrasting accent + neutralized blue-gray controls
purple primary + derived pale purple + contrasting accent + neutralized purple-gray controls
custom pink primary and automatically derived full Shadow Sage palette
